name: Kyle Shanahan's Wide Zone Family
description: The premier modern NFL offensive system built on horizontal stretch sequencing. The base Outside Zone run and its three constraint counters (Play-Action Deep Over, Naked Bootleg, and Jet Motion) start from the same look. Play-Action Deep Over and Naked Bootleg stay close to the base run through the first 1.2 seconds and Jet Motion shows itself sooner, but each one puts defenders in a run-pass conflict.
